title: Dune Watch
meta_description: Gulf & State Park Views, Near Beach Access- Dune Watch by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Dune Watch by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 345 Pine Street Details: Dune Watch is a beautifully renovated coastal retreat ideally positioned next to Grayton Beach State Park, offering incredible views of the Gulf and the surrounding natural landscape. Expanded and completely renovated in 2024, this inviting home offers approximately 1,789 square feet of interior living space and comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with five bedrooms and 4.5 baths. Thoughtfully designed interiors, a fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable gathering spaces make Dune Watch an ideal setting for families and groups enjoying time together along 30A. Outdoor living is a highlight of the home, with a covered front porch offering exceptional sunset views over the Gulf and Grayton Beach State Park. Beneath the home, a bed swing provides a relaxing spot for an afternoon nap, while outdoor dining and a hot/cold shower make days at the beach even more convenient. Grayton Beach State Park beach access is approximately 150 feet from the home, and the restaurants, galleries, and laid-back character of downtown Grayton Beach are easily accessible by a scenic walk along the beach. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 150 Feet to Grayton Beach State Park Beach Access -Distance to Downtown Grayton Beach: Approximately 15-20 Minute Beach Walk -Parking Spaces: (6) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8-10, Outdoor Dining for 12 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Gulf and Grayton Beach State Park Views -Covered Front Porch with Sunset Views -Outdoor Bed Swing -Outdoor Hot/Cold Shower -Outdoor Charcoal Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Bedrooms / 4.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin XL/Twin XL Built-In Bunks with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Laundry Closet -Half Bath -Covered Porch Please Note: *Beach vendors are not permitted to set up chairs or umbrellas within Grayton Beach State Park. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
